title: Case Study: Slashing Inventory Shrinkage from 14% to 0.4% in 60 Days
content:
A prominent Egyptian wholesale FMCG distributor with a 3,500 m² central hub was losing an estimated 14% of gross inventory every quarter to unexplained shrinkage, damaged goods, and unrecorded return shipments.

Their legacy workflow:
- Picking orders written by hand on duplicate carbon paper slips.
- Drivers loading trucks before dispatch invoices were recorded.
- Monthly inventory audits took 14 days and required completely halting dispatches.

In July 2026, Scando was brought in to lead a 60-day turnaround using The Scando Method.

Here was our 3-phase tactical deployment:
Phase 1 (Days 1–20): Mandatory Barcode Reception & Put-Away
Every arriving pallet received a serialized barcode label. No item could be binned without a terminal scan matching the supplier Purchase Order.

Phase 2 (Days 21–40): System-Enforced Dispatch Gate
Security gates were integrated into the workflow. The gate guard cannot open the boom barrier without scanning a digital dispatch barcode confirming picking slip, invoice, and truck license plate match 100%.

Phase 3 (Days 41–60): Cycle Counting on Mobile
Replaced quarterly shutdowns with daily 15-minute rolling cycle counts of 20 random SKUs.

Key Outcomes at Day 60:
→ Inventory shrinkage dropped from 14.2% to 0.38%.
→ Monthly stockout incidents decreased by 78%.
→ Quarterly audit shutdown eliminated entirely, recovering 56 operational shipping days per year.

Practical operational control beats massive multi-year IT promises.
